title: How To Delete a Widget
text:
## How To Delete a Widget
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000078436
Deleting a custom widget permanently removes it from a website. This can't be undone, so be sure the widget can be removed completely before continuing.
Disabling a custom widget may be a better option if the goal is to deactivate the widget while keeping it available for future use. To learn how, refer to How To Disable a Widget
Keep in mind that only custom or brand-new widgets can be deleted — this option does not apply to default widgets. If the deleted widget is a customized copy of a default widget, the default version automatically takes over on the live site again, bringing back default functionality.
To delete a widget, navigate to Toolbox >> Widget Manager and click Delete in the Actions dropdown:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12184958627/original/TK3KFqdddkhQ6dAr1SFcYMt70OnFZfaXsQ.png?1789005979 | alt: ]
Once clicked, a confirmation pop-up will appear:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12184958635/original/_J4cv_Wi9DkmKzbFV0ngjZeA0yC7zPPoUQ.png?1789006004 | alt: ]
Once confirmed, the widget is removed from the website permanently .
